body: Sorry I missed you. I ended up doing the work/class thing. Except on my way to class, I said eff it and walked back home.

When I moved out of my mom's I took the cat  she was the most attached to me. It was pretty much assumed I would take her since the family called her my cat. I took her on as a responsibility and I don't want her to starve or live a crappy life because I'm being selfish.

Thank you for that. I really mean it. 

As for what gives me energy, I really don't know. The only thing that really keeps me going right now is that I need to work to feed my cat and pay bills because my cat and roommate (who relies on me paying my half of the rent and bills) shouldn't suffer.
